jq 1.7
Licence: MIT; its documentation CC BY 3.0; parts under other permissive licences (COPYING in this folder).
  This build contains the regular-expression library Oniguruma, which jq brings with it
  (2-clause BSD licence: ONIGURUMA-COPYING in this folder; https://github.com/kkos/oniguruma).
Upstream source: https://github.com/jqlang/jq/tree/jq-1.7
WebAssembly build: Biowasm (https://biowasm.com/), downloaded from
  https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/jq/1.7/ on 2026-10-01
Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

Local change to the JavaScript loader: exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the
terminal of the practical keeps the exit status of a failed command.
Modified file: jq.js
jq.wasm is unmodified.

This build does not know its own version number (jq --version prints "jq-"); the terminal of the
practical answers jq --version itself, with "jq-1.7".
